newsitem.title: USA: Intercell to receive additional warrants.
newsitem.headline: Intercell to receive additional warrants.

text.p: Intercell Corp a technology holding company, said Tuesday that it will receive additional warrants from Intercell Technology Corp in connection with the sale of its wireless antenna technology.
The transaction, said the company, is still subject to the execution of a definitive agreement and the completion of due diligence.

If completed, Intercell Corp will receive one warrant for each two common shares delivered by Intercell Technology. Intercell Technology will also deliver one common share of its stock for every five shares of Intercell Corp's common stock issued and outstanding on the date of closing.
As of March 31 Intercell had approximately 18 million shares outstanding.
The additional warrants, exercisable at $4.00 per share, have a term of five years from the closing date and carry certain registration rights.

No determination has been made on whether the warrants will be distributed to the shareholders of Intercell Corp, or on a record date for the distribution of the common shares received in the transaction, said the company.
